summary.zh: 登录方式重新梳理：自部署 OAuth 设置从设置页迁移至登录页（登录前即可配置），设置页移除该入口。
summary.en: Login flow reorganized: the self-hosted OAuth configuration moved from Settings to the login page (configurable before signing in); the Settings entry is removed.

items.zh: 登录页新增「自部署 OAuth 登录设置」入口，弹出配置弹窗，作为第三种登录方式
items.en: Login page gains a self-hosted OAuth entry opening the config sheet, as a third sign-in method

items.zh: 设置页移除「自定义 OAuth Client」入口（登录前无法到达，位置不合理）
items.en: Removed the "Custom OAuth Client" entry from Settings (unreachable before signing in)

items.zh: 修复登录页组件链接未导入导致的构建失败
items.en: Fixed a build failure from a missing component import
